tha-ap399:1.3: matā → ca (bj, sya-all, pts) | bhātā → bhātā ca (sya-all)

tha-ap399:4.4: āgañchi → āgacchi (bj); agacchi (pts) | santikaṁ → santike (bj, sya-all, pts)

tha-ap399:6.2: udapajjatha tadāsimekaggamano → upapajjatha tadāsi mekaggamano (bj, sya-all)
tha-ap399:9.1: anavhitā → anavahitā (bj); anavhatā (sya-all); anavhātā (pts) | āguṁ ananuññātā → āgā nānuññātā (sya-all)
tha-ap399:11.1: vasse ca → vasseva (sya-all) | ca te → ete (pts)
tha-ap399:13.2: saṁ tacaṁ → santananuṁ (sya-all) | tacaṁ → saṁtanuṁ (cck: syā. ka.)
tha-ap399:14.4: buddhaseṭṭhaṁ avandahaṁ → buddhaseṭṭhamavandihaṁ (bj); buddhasettham avandi haṁ (pts) | buddhaseṭṭhamavandihaṁ → buddhaseṭṭhaṁ avandahaṁ (bj: machasaṁ)
tha-ap399:15.2: pūjayiṁ girimañjariṁ dibbagandhaṁ sampavantaṁ → girimañjarimapūjayiṁ dibbagandhena sampannaṁ (bj); girimañjari pūjayī dibbagandhena sampannaṁ (sya-all) | girimañjariṁ dibbagandhaṁ sampavantaṁ → dibbagandhena sampannaṁ (pts) | girimañjarimapūjayiṁ → pūjayiṁ girimañjariṁ (bj: machasaṁ) | girimañjariṁ → girimañjarimapūjayiṁ (cck: sī. syā.)
tha-ap399:15.3: sampannaṁ → dibbagandhaṁ sampavattaṁ (bj: machasaṁ) | sampavantaṁ → dibbagandhena sampannaṁ (cck: sī. syā.)
tha-ap399:17.1: nittiṇṇosi → vitiṇṇosi (sya-all); nitthiṇṇo si (pts) | nittiṇṇosi → tittaṇhosi (bj: katthaci) | Nittiṇṇosi → nittaṇhosi (cck: sī.); vitiṇṇosi (cck: syā.)
tha-ap399:17.2: sabbaññu → sabbaññū (bj) | sabbaññu lokanāyaka → sabbaññū lokanāyako (sya-all, pts)
tha-ap399:19.1: vasipattā → siddhipattā (sya-all) | ca → vasippannā ca (bj: machasaṁ) | vasipattā → siddhipattā (cck: sī. syā.)

tha-ap399:21.2: duruttaro → atulopi duruttaro (bj: machasaṁ) | atulopi → yathā samuddo akkhobho, atulo ca (cck: sī.)

tha-ap399:24.3: jhāyī → cāpi (sya-all) | jhāyī paṭisallānagocaro → cāpi paṭisallāṇagocaro (pts)
tha-ap399:25.4: sadā vivekamanuyuttomhi → tadā vivekamanuyuttombhi (bj); tadā vivekam anuyutto mhi (pts)
